verdict: APPROVED. P1 is resolved. The only production change is final_failure: it reads inherited stderr with F_GETFL and writes the optional diagnostic only if stderr is already O_NONBLOCK, bounded to 100 ms. It never calls probe_flags, F_SETFL or F_SETFD on fd 2. child.c, probe_common.h and qualify.py are byte-identical to rev001, so every rev001 producer and classifier conclusion carries over unchanged. Source and host-test evidence only; no Darwin result.

Across the whole parent, the only remaining probe_flags calls are on the parent's own new pipe and socketpair ends (lines 55-56). There is no F_SETFL/F_SETFD and no other fcntl on fds 0-2. There are no new opens, no restore path, and every final_failure path still returns 1.

There is a new tenth negative control (F_GETFL replaced by probe_flags(2,0)). Rerun on a scratch copy: 10/10 OK, with 10 negative controls.

residual_note: The trade-off is accepted by design. A normal blocking console stderr skips the optional line, so in final_failure cases the failing stage name may appear nowhere. The parent's actual exit status in the supervisor's STATUS line and the mandatory closed export stay authoritative. Root's pipeline also binds result nonce = decoded export nonce = supervisor nonce, which covers my rev001 note P5. The other rev001 notes (P2-P4, P6, P7) are unchanged and non-blocking.
